title: keteleeria davidiana var. chien-peii
intro: Keteleeria davidiana var. chien-peii, commonly known as Chinese fir, is a variant of the evergreen coniferous tree species Keteleeria davidiana. This plant is used in traditional Chinese medicine, valued for its potential health benefits and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Chinese fir include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help to alleviate respiratory issues, fever, and other ailments. The bioactive constituents of Chinese fir include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antiviral activities.
